name: io.github.Ynewtime/markitai
title: markitai
description: Convert documents, images and web pages to clean Markdown, for agents: single, URL and batch tools.

environmentVariables.name: MODEL
environmentVariables.description: provider/model for --llm enhancement, e.g. gemini/gemini-flash-lite-latest; with the matching API key env var set

environmentVariables.name: MARKITAI_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Markitai's configuration, cache and model directory (default ~/.markitai)
